races.why_note: The Chicago Board of Education's first voter-elected president. Chicago is moving from a mayor-appointed board to a fully elected 21-member board; the president is elected citywide for the first time on Nov 3, 2026.

timeline.note: Petition challenges heard; ballot finalized

timeline.note: Ballots mailed to voters who requested them

timeline.label: Election Day
timeline.note: First voter-elected Chicago Board of Education

timeline.label: New elected board seated
timeline.note: Fully elected 21-member board takes office

candidates.office: President of the Board of Education

races.why_note: A Chicago Board of Education subdistrict seat. As the hybrid appointed/elected board phases out, these subdistrict seats are filled by voters. Some districts elected a member in 2024 and others were mayor-appointed — the 2026 election is part of completing the fully elected board.
